events.text:
The trader is alone, so it needs to reach the single door at (17,17)/(17,19) by a route that works on the water.

**Key facts:**
- The bottom island (door at (17,19)) is cut off by one water cell, (17,16), below the left island cell (17,15).
- Only boulders can sink to make walkable floor. A sunk mirror does not.
- The mirror at (21,12) can teleport the trader between (17,12) and (21,16), so it crosses the water without a bridge.
- Boulder #4 is pushed up to row 13 and west into (18,13), which sinks and makes that cell floor. This links the two sides.
- The mirror is moved to (20,11). From (20,14) it teleports the trader to (17,11), directly north of (17,12).
- Boulder #1 is pushed east from (15,12) to (17,12) before that teleport. From (17,11) the trader pushes it south down column 17 into (17,16), which sinks, and then walks to the door.

**Walkthrough:**
1. `URU`: trader to (17,12).
2. `X`: teleported to (21,16).
3. `RUU`: pushes boulder #4 north to (22,13).
4. `RULLLL`: pushes it west into (18,13), which sinks.
5. `RRU`: pushes the mirror north to (21,11).
6. `RUL`: pushes the mirror west to (20,11).
7. `DDLLLLLLURDRRRRDX`: walks to (15,12), pushes boulder #1 east to (17,12), walks to (20,14), then teleports to (17,11).
8. `DDDDDDDD`: pushes the boulder south into (17,16), then walks to the door at (17,19).
